block: dsfd_rly_536_EN (E in -> N out corner relay, 56.16 sq, pin flops at the E input face)
purpose: electrical reach (H-REACH stnv566 finding: receiver first-cell HB2xp67 max transition fails at 225 um when the sender pin is weak); diagnostic direct routes on AGIdock, NOT published, NOT for binding

variants.mode: BUFx8 seeded at the pin, PLACED (OT_OUT_DRV_FREE)

classification: Every strong-pin-driver form FAILS native launch (<=220). Cause is structural: the corner relay's pin flop sits at its E input face (bit 4 flop (49.2,2.2), out pin (2.6,56.1)), so each bit carries up to ~100 um of internal flop->pin wire; the unbuffered view splits it with hold-repair BUFx2s (launch 200.1). A driver at either end of that wire adds a stage or a slow QN->big-input-cap leg.
next: structural: corner relays place the pin flop at the OUTPUT face (long internal wire on the capture side behind the BUFx4f input-hold driver, capture budget 190 has ~45 ps room) and keep a strong out-pin driver; or replace corner relays with straight relays + die-side turn. Electrical reach itself is measured by H-REACH on r1 (BUFx8 at the pin) vs the unbuffered baselines.
